text:
Priya: PSA: brought a tiny guest home — Gidget the hedgehog fell asleep in my hoodie pocket on the commute. pic: https://files.redwood.ai/uploads/gidget-pocket.jpg
Daniel: *squeee* that's illegal levels of adorable :heart_eyes:
Yvonne: does it snore? asking for a friend.
Priya: yes, gentle potato snuffles. also rolled into a perfect burrito when I nudged the pocket.
Carlos: petition to replace standup with hedgehog cuddles on Fridays.
PetBot: Poll created: "Gidget cuddle duty on Fridays" — 2 yes, 1 no
Daniel: sending to my partner, now begging for a hedgehog. brb looking up care guides.
Yvonne: remind me: are they legal in CA? (I can't be the one to check)
Priya: checked — allowed with permit in our county. also tiny hedgehog sweater arrived today: https://files.redwood.ai/uploads/gidget-sweater.jpg
Carlos: omg that sweater. he's the CEO of tiny sweaters.
PetBot: Reaction: :thumbsup: x5
Priya: low-key considering an office cameo next week. would anyone object to a 10-min "meet Gidget" slot?
Daniel: absolutely not. sign me up.
Yvonne: I'd volunteer to bring snacks (for humans). Gidget prefers mealworms apparently.
Carlos: noted. no surprise-party-fluffing without consent.
Priya: ok meeting invite incoming. she/he/they prefers the pronoun squeak. thanks team :)
